name: LedgerMCP
description:
Free bookkeeping software for your business or personal finances. AI becomes your bookkeeper. Hand it your bank statements, ask questions in plain English, and it keeps everything categorized in the app.
 
Free to use. If you'd rather connect live bank feeds than upload statements every month, log in on the website.

For businesses
Everything a bookkeeper would do for you:
- Categorizes expenses
- Matches transfers between accounts
- Add Tags to track projects & vendors, etc.
- Track spending & savings
- Reconcile accounts to statements
- Profit & loss, balance sheet, track for 1099s, simple Schedule C categorization

For personal finances
The same thing, but for your own money:
- Categorize your spend
- Set budgets
- Net worth to see your assets vs. liabilities
- Find subscriptions you forgot about
- Flags charges that look wrong: charged twice, an odd amount, one you don't recognize.
- See how much your saving (or overspending)
- Transaction calendar with upcoming income and expenses
+more

_published_faq.name: How do I add LedgerMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LedgerMCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.ledgermcp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LedgerMCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LedgerMCP lists 63 MCP tools, including add_convention, add_transaction, allocate_transaction, archive_business, ask_user, attach_receipt, book_depreciation, budget_report, bulk_categorize, cash_calendar, categorize_transaction, and confirm_transfer.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LedgerMCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LedgerMCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
LedgerMCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LedgerMCP is developed by LedgerMCP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
